source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_59/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_59/training_2.csv"

source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # ['movie_id', 'title', 'genres']
source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # ['user_id', 'gender', 'age', 'occupation', 'zip']
source2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)  # ['user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating', 'timestamp']

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN Source2_59_2 and Source2_59_1 on user_id
joined_1 = pd.merge(source2, source1, on="user_id", how="inner")

# 2) JOIN the result with Source2_59_0 on movie_id
joined_2 = pd.merge(joined_1, source0, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Reorder and ensure columns and types match the target schema:
# Target Schema: ['user_id': int, 'movie_id': int, 'rating': int, 'timestamp': int,
#                 'gender': string, 'age': int, 'occupation': int, 'zip': string,
#                 'title': string, 'genres': string]

# Enforce correct dtypes explicitly
joined_2 = joined_2.astype({
    'user_id': 'int64',
    'movie_id': 'int64',
    'rating': 'int64',
    'timestamp': 'int64',
    'gender': 'string',
    'age': 'int64',
    'occupation': 'int64',
    'zip': 'string',
    'title': 'string',
    'genres': 'string'
})

# Select columns in the exact order of the target schema
target_df = joined_2[['user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating', 'timestamp',
                      'gender', 'age', 'occupation', 'zip',
                      'title', 'genres']]

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_59/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_59/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# First join Source2_59_2 and Source2_59_1 on user_id (inner join)
result = pd.merge(source2, source1, how="inner", on="user_id")

# Then join the above result with Source2_59_0 on movie_id (inner join)
result = pd.merge(result, source0, how="inner", on="movie_id")

# Write the final output with exact target schema and column order
result = result[[
    "user_id", "movie_id", "rating", "timestamp",
    "gender", "age", "occupation", "zip",
    "title", "genres"
]]
